description:
A Stripe Checkout link that adds prepaid credit to this workspace. Nothing is charged by this call: give url to the user, who pays by card; the credit lands seconds after payment (get_balance confirms).

Billing: free — the user pays only if they complete the checkout. The link expires after 24 hours.

When to call: a paid tool returned out_of_credits, or the credit is short for the run the user asked for. Suggest an amount that covers the planned work and say what it's for.

Returns { url, amount_cents, amount_usd, expires_at, note }. An agent workspace (no account behind it) also gets claim_url: the user opens it to sign up and take over the workspace.

amount_cents.description: Credit to add, in whole cents: 500–100000 ($5–$1000), e.g. 2500.

name: create_top_up_link
title: Create a Stripe checkout link to add AuditAE credit
